title: Illusionist / 幻术师
description:
A standalone mirror-and-illusion character for Slay the Spire 2, with three coupled systems:

- Mirror: "Copy" summons mirror images that replay your first card each turn and shatter when you take unblocked damage.
- Intent: read and reflect enemy telegraphs (Counter, Foresight, Provoke).
- Transmute: temporarily reshape your own cards (Shifting Blade, Myriad Faces, Phantom Blast), with a transmute stack that unwinds one layer per turn.

~40 themed cards, custom relics and potions, a starter relic, and Orobas (Ancient) relic/card upgrades.

Fully localized in English and 简体中文.
changeNote: v0.4.0 - Stability release: the mod now runs on the RitsuLib base library. NEW REQUIREMENT: subscribe to RitsuLib (STS2-RitsuLib) on the Workshop - the game will prompt you via the dependency. Under the hood the hand-rolled patches were replaced by RitsuLib's character/content/keyword systems, which should make the mod much more robust across game updates. NOTE: content IDs were namespaced, so card-discovery records and any mid-run save with the Illusionist from older versions will reset (your other characters are unaffected). Custom mechanics (Copy / Mirror Image / First Move / Transmute) are now real keywords with hover tips. Fix: Riposte's turn-start revert no longer shows the card preview twice. English & 简体中文.
